prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE game illustration atlas, six vertical paintings in an exact 3-column x 2-row grid, 1536x1536 total, each tile 512 wide x768 high. No margins or dividers, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no card frames. Sophisticated hand painted gouache with expressive fine ink, European fantasy graphic novel meets Japanese RPG, sage green, ivory, muted gold, luminous magic, textured paint. Each tile fills its entire rectangle, important subject in upper two thirds; darker detailed bottom third will receive HTML text overlay. Six distinct illustrations in reading order: top left: adult battle alchemist in practical green leather coat holding glowing amber and teal potion bottles amid herbs, smoke and alchemical glass. Top middle: adult blood knight in full dark plate armor, pale stern face, red cape, crimson magic and shadow tendrils, gothic darkness, no gore. Top right: knight of the beautiful lady, adult courteous knight in silver plate armor kneeling with sword and white rose before a distant adult fully clothed noble lady, luminous golden blessing. Bottom left: ocean of experience, immense turquoise ocean wave made of tiny golden stars flowing toward an adult wandering hero on a stone promontory. Bottom middle: genius, adult thoughtful robed scholar, luminous constellation diagram around head and hands, golden books and thoughtful face. Bottom right: streak of victories, adult armored adventurer progressing along a path of repeated radiant golden steps with defeated small fantasy monster silhouettes, dynamic confident forward stride. All images share one polished coherent painterly visual language. No sexual content.

Input image is identity and painted style reference: use ONLY the adult MAN at the LEFT, do not include the woman. Show the same adult man age 28, elongated handsome face, slim neck, modest bare shoulders and upper chest only, THREE IDENTICALLY registered waist-up portraits each 512x1024 tile with generous clear padding. Same expression: skeptical, quietly resigned, same pose, same facial proportions and same long hair shape. Variant 1 left: long sky blue hair, red irises. Variant 2 middle: long forest green hair, gold irises. Variant 3 right: long black-and-white striped hair and gray eyes like the reference. He is slim with only lightly defined muscles. Maintain mature adult appearance. No weapons, no clothes covering shoulders, but cropped safely at upper chest, no lower body, no nudity below chest. Rich fine ink and hand painted gouache, warm ivory illumination, exact same rendering as reference. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, no checkerboard, no text, no borders, no extra people.

EXACT regular grid, generous clear transparent margin, true alpha no checkerboard, no text no labels no visible cell boundaries.
